Bare filename href (no URI scheme) renders as inline link, not autolink (#397)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<a href="foobar.png">foobar.png</a>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
